gallery_categories.title: Acrylic Laser Cutting Grills
gallery_categories.description: Decorative CNC/laser-cut jaali-pattern acrylic grill panels used as false-ceiling inserts, room dividers, and wall partitions in home interiors.

gallery_categories.title: Acrylic Mandir Background
gallery_categories.description: Backlit and engraved acrylic panels used as home-temple (mandir) backgrounds, including deity portraits, Om/Ganesh motifs, and jaali-pattern backlit inserts.

gallery_categories.title: Acrylic Bending Products
gallery_categories.description: Bent-acrylic products: magazine/wall racks, colored table stands, trays with handles, gift boxes, menu/card display stands.

gallery_categories.title: Acrylic Memento
gallery_categories.description: Custom-engraved acrylic trophies and mementos for weddings, birthdays, father's day, cycling clubs, and corporate/sports awards.

gallery_categories.title: Events Backdrops
gallery_categories.description: Acrylic monogram/name backdrops and cutout lettering combined with balloon and floral decor for weddings, birthdays, and engagements.

gallery_categories.title: Acrylic Engraving Name Plates
gallery_categories.description: Engraved directional/floor signage, table tent cards (e.g. 'table is sanitized'), door/room name plates, and department signage strips.

gallery_categories.title: Vinyl Printing
gallery_categories.description: Large-format vinyl printing (Epson printer shown), government emblem/seal prints, and on-site wall installation in a meeting room.

gallery_categories.title: Auto Glow Sign Boards
gallery_categories.description: Photoluminescent (glow-in-the-dark) safety signage: fire exit, fire extinguisher, fire alarm call point, no smoking, restricted area, parking/no entry signs.

gallery_categories.title: Plotter Cutting
gallery_categories.description: Graphtec cutting plotter in action, vinyl lettering/decal application (e.g. store hours), rolls of colored vinyl, and die-cut stickers.

gallery_categories.title: School Bus Branding
gallery_categories.description: Vinyl-wrapped exterior branding for school and university buses — examples shown for Delhi Public School Miyapur and Woxsen University.

gallery_categories.title: Neon LED Boards
gallery_categories.description: Custom flex-neon name signs, the 'Lucky Signs' shop sign, and event neon ('Happy Birthday', 'Better Together', 'Let's Party').

gallery_categories.title: LED Name Plates
gallery_categories.description: Backlit acrylic house/office name plates with house numbers and family names (e.g. Kaushalya, Bhat Villa, Md Ibrahim Mansion, Jogendra Singh Meena).

gallery_categories.title: LED Sign Boards
gallery_categories.description: Illuminated storefront/facade signage installed for clients: Tatva Modern Dining, The Broast Factory, Mythri Hospital, Crystal Hospital.

gallery_categories.title: Internal Sign Boards
gallery_categories.description: Indoor office branding and nameplates — Hopper Automation, a financial advisor's desk plate, a GHMC zonal commissioner plaque, Phoenix Techzone/Aquila, Alankaran Events, Ahimsa Dental Spa.
